title: A Border for the Safehouse
author: Yara Halloran
blurb: Cyrus Sterling, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
